conclusion: Partially supported: MISEV2023 (ev-misev2023-quality-framework) supports, at the guideline/consensus level, the need for orthogonal characterization, defined release/assays, and transparent production reporting as prerequisites to de-risk advancing intact-EV formulations. However, the available evidence does not contain any program-specific CMC, assay validation, manufacturing, stability, or in vivo bridging data, so claims that the program has (or must demonstrably produce) specific MCB/WCB records, validated intact-EV release assays, GMP-like batch comparability reports, or GLP large-animal biodistribution/tox data are unsupported by the provided evidence set.
unsupported_assertions: That program-specific MCB/WCB creation and characterization dossiers exist or have been produced (no MCB/WCB records present in provided evidence).

That fit-for-purpose validation reports for orthogonal intact-EV release assays (including LLOQ, specificity, accuracy/precision) have been performed and are available (no assay validation data present).
That a stability-indicating potency assay has been developed and linked to an in vivo PD endpoint (no stability/potency correlation data present).
That three GMP-like batch manufacturing reports with release, stability, and comparability analyses have been completed (no batch manufacturing or comparability reports present).
That GLP or equivalent large-animal intranasal biodistribution/tox studies with appropriate controls demonstrating intact-EV detection have been completed (no GLP biodistribution/tox data present).
